name: Nexels
definition: A representation that decouples geometry and appearance using surfels for geometry and a combination of a global neural field and per-primitive colours for appearance. It uses a fixed number of primitives per pixel to ensure low compute.
summary: Nexels is a novel view synthesis method that decouples geometry and appearance using surfels and a shared neural field to texture only the top-K primitives per pixel, ensuring real-time performance with significantly fewer primitives than 3D Gaussian Splatting.
